title: Certify exact low-degree outputs through sparse high-degree intermediate states
statement: Propagate full Boolean ANFs, cancel union products, then test a term budgetM after each gate and cubic degree only at the final output. Every accepted output is globally exact; sparse degree-six or higher intermediates may cancel safely.

requires: Causal XOR/AND/NOT/constant circuit and explicit term budget
provides: Propagate full Boolean ANFs, cancel union products, then test a term budgetM after each gate and cubic degree only at the final output. Every accepted output is globally exact; sparse degree-six or higher intermediates may cancel safely.
assumptions: Budget is a numerical resource, not free when encoded in binary
Intermediate overflow may reject even a constant final output
costs: Bit timeO(|C|+n^2+S M^2 n log(M+2)); spaceO(|C|+n^2+(SM+M^2)n)
contract.units: Original independent Boolean bits; exact binary/cyclotomic/finite-field arithmetic and source-local rank parameters. No physical resource conversion.
contract.obstruction: An intermediate-degree cap rejects useful sparse cancellations; truncation is not final-degree certification.

body: No internal gate becomes an independent counting input. After exact compilation, centroid/rank conditions must still pass.

evidence.range_scope: Actual source statement/construction and its conditions; read the governing version.

review.scope: Source-exposed internal review of this exact construction; conditional counting remains conditional. Scientific programs not replayed by intake.
